# Final Discovery Plan

The Awtsmoos now demands the buried route graph be seen before any file is reshaped;
Awtsmoos.com will index reality as implemented, not a fantasy sitemap draped.

## Atomic discovery

A. Root routing and public catalog
B. Alias routing/profile publication
C. Comment/reply data flow, translation fields, author alias resolution
D. App registry and app landing routes
E. Game registry and game landing routes
F. Existing robots/sitemap architecture
G. Dynamic/static server behavior for direct files and route templates
H. Privacy/auth/admin exclusions
I. Representative current public raw HTML
J. Existing tests around each route family

## Decision gates

- Dedicated comment page vs parent-page anchors is decided only after route inspection.
- Dynamic vs generated sitemap family is decided after enumeration cost inspection.
- Alias/apps/games SSR changes are decided after raw HTML inspection.

## Completion target

A crawler starting at `/robots.txt` must be able to discover every stable public resource through valid sitemap families and ordinary semantic links, and every discovered resource must expose meaningful text/metadata without requiring JavaScript.
